name: Quick March
body:
School transmutation; Level antipaladin 2, cleric/oracle 2, paladin 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Target allies in a 20-foot-radius burst
Duration 1 round
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

All the affected allies gain a 30-foot enhancement bonus to their base speed.
